Unicorns Of Kojan

Level 24 · Adventuring · Lomshir

Objectives

Find the unicorns Grathael and Athanalor. They are on separate small islands in the Kojani Archipelago. Speak to them and return to Adaenyl at Shadow's End with the ceratescryer. - Reestablish Contact with Grathael - Reestablish Contact with Athanalor - Ceratescryer (0/1)

Description

Adaenyl says, "I am now finding two unicorns far to the north of us, in the Kojani Archipelago. Their names are Grathael and Athanalor, and they each seem to be on their own small islands." "Aid these unicorns as you aided Raynien. Take the ceratescryer to them so that they can link with me, then return the device to me so I may point it in another direction to search for more unicorns."

What they say

On offering it

Adaenyl says, "I am now finding two unicorns far to the north of us, in the Kojani Archipelago. Their names are Grathael and Athanalor, and they each seem to be on their own small islands." "Aid these unicorns as you aided Raynien. Take the ceratescryer to them so that they can link with me, then return the device to me so I may point it in another direction to search for more unicorns."

Recorded by vg.curse.com.

Notes

Grathael is in the Seas of Mist (-20, 10) on the southern island. /loc 38274, 73028, 10499 in Seas of Mist (-20, 10) Athanalor is in the Ceros Isle (-19, 9) on the southeastern island. /loc 49806, 35190, 6121 in Ceros Isle (-19, 8) Closest riftstone in in Tanvu.<gallery captionalign="left"> unicorn10.jpg|Grathael and Athanalor. Credits to VG Walkthroughs. </gallery>

findings.observation: The objective names Grathael and Athanalor on separate Kojani Archipelago islands, asks the player to speak to both and return the ceratescryer to Adaenyl at Shadow s End. Only Ceratescryer has an explicit 0/1 counter; the two contact objectives have no numeric counters.
Description and offering dialogue repeat the device-link narrative and reference earlier help to Raynien. This does not independently verify device-use mechanics or enforce a prerequisite.
Notes place Grathael on the southern island in Seas of Mist (-20, 10), with /loc 38274, 73028, 10499. These are attributed notes, not independently verified spawns.

Notes place Athanalor on the southeastern island in Ceros Isle, but first print (-19, 9) and then (-19, 8) alongside /loc 49806, 35190, 6121. Both conflicting grid labels are retained; neither is chosen as canonical.
The nearest-riftstone note names Tanvu; missing gallery markup credits VG Walkthroughs. No image contents or travel rules are inferred.

The page labels Level 24, Adventuring, Lomshir, starts/hand-in Adaenyl, Unicorn series, previous Testing The Finder and next Extraordinary Response. Navigation and displayed levels do not establish enforced quest order or minimum player level.

Curse and fandom objective variants are retained in full article and source records. The archive aggregation and MMODB source URL are not independent corroboration and upstream bodies were not downloaded in this review.
No Rewards section is printed. Device delivery is not evidence of a reward; XP, coin and reward items remain unknown.
